sections.Profile:
The "Raven" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in March 1986, features a military theme with design by John Trudeau and artwork by Don Marshall and Larry Day. It is a solid-state machine that includes two flippers, one ramp, and an alphanumeric display. The game is noted for its unique backglass art, depicting a female soldier.
